title: Count Number of Homogenous Substrings
description: A string is homogenous if all characters in it are identical. Given a lowercase string `s`, return the total number of non-empty homogenous contiguous substrings of `s`, modulo `1,000,000,007`.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: A maximal run of length L of the same character contributes L * (L + 1) / 2 homogenous substrings.
Equivalently, track the current run length ending at index i and add it to the total modulo 10^9 + 7.
